name: Cinema Glass
concept: Full-bleed imagery seen through dark blurred glass, with chrome reduced to floating pills.

type.families: Geometric sans for chrome; a high-contrast display serif or italic didone permitted for one hero line. Monospace acceptable for timecodes and metadata.
type.hierarchy: Hero 52/58 regular, optionally breaking mid-line into italic serif · control label 12/16 medium · metadata 11/14 mono · body 15/23 regular at 66% white.
type.usage: The signature move is a grotesque headline that breaks into italic display serif for one clause. Keep all chrome type small and quiet so the image carries the frame.

tokens.texture: Glass over film. Panels use `background: rgba(24,24,24,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(120%);` with a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.14)` inner stroke. Behind them, full-bleed photography or a defocused macro fills the entire viewport. A 4-6% grain overlay unifies the composite. Never place a solid opaque panel over the image — everything floats translucent.
tokens.layout: The image is the layout. Chrome reduces to floating pills and small glass cards docked to edges and corners, leaving the centre of the frame to the photograph. 8px scale, 999px radius on controls, 18-24px on glass cards, 16px padding. Content sits in the lower third or along one edge, never centred over the subject.

best_for: creative tools with a visual output

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as cinematic photograph, shallow depth of field, film grain.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- full-bleed photographic image, dark overall exposure
- single strong light source with deep shadows retaining detail
- desaturated except one hot accent note near #D9E82A
- visible fine film grain
- wide cinematic framing with the subject off-centre

NEGATIVE SPACE: The lower third must fall dark and uncluttered for glass panels and type.

DO NOT INCLUDE: flat vector, bright even lighting, white backgrounds, stock-photo smiles, HDR over-processing, text or UI in the image.
image_recipe.provider: configurable — set to your image provider
image_recipe.model: configurable — set to your image model
image_recipe.resolution: 1536x1024 (3:2 landscape); use 1024x1536 for portrait, 1024x1024 for square
